p: waters issued out from under the: By which are meant the spiritual graces that would be given to the Church under the kingdom of Christ.
river that could not be passed: Signifying that the graces of God would never decrease, but ever abound in his Church.
trees on the one side and: Meaning, the multitude of them that would be refreshed by the spiritual waters.

sea: Showing that the abundance of these graces would be so great, that all the world would be full of it, which is here meant by the Persian sea, or Genezareth, and the sea called Mediterranean, Zec 14:8.
healed: The waters which by nature are salt and unwholesome will be made sweet and comfortable.
fishermen shall stand upon it from: Signifying that when God bestows his mercies in such abundance the ministers will by their preaching win many.
Eneglaim: Which were cities at the corners of the salt or dead sea.
the great sea: They will be here of all sorts and in as great abundance as in the great ocean where they are bred.
its miry places and its marshes: That is, the wicked and reprobate.
of the land toward the north: By the land of promise he signifies the spiritual land of which this was a figure.

they shall have inheritance with you: Meaning that in this spiritual kingdom there would be no difference between Jew nor Gentile but that all would be partakers of this inheritance in their head Christ.
